title: What Scripture Actually Means by "A Man With No Walls"
caption:
A man with no self-control isn't weak. Scripture calls him a city with no walls: breached, not undisciplined.

The wall was never willpower. It's built one named gate at a time, and the Spirit lays the stones you can't lay alone.

Name the gate you leave open. Then start guarding it on purpose.

#faith #selfcontrol #proverbs #christianmen #discipline #manofgod
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
